signature: INTEGER FUNCTION ILAZLC( M, N, A, LDA )

params.name: m
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A.

params.name: N

params.name: A

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.
